title: What AI-Native Looks Like
summary: An article exploring what AI-native development looks like in practice, likely discussing how to build software where AI capabilities are core to the architecture rather than afterthought integrations.
problem_solved: Clarifying what truly AI-native applications and infrastructure look like versus AI-as-feature approaches
why_valuable: Provides architectural guidance for developers and companies trying to understand how to genuinely build AI-first products rather than just adding AI features to existing systems
